A: Both methods should receive few snapshots during the 30s quiet phase; SSE should keep one stream while long polling expires and starts another GET.
B: Both methods should promptly detect real progress; SSE can deliver multiple snapshots in one GET, while long polling starts another GET after each response.
C: SSE should carry frequent updates in one stream; long polling may need many GETs or skip coalesced versions. Request counts alone cannot establish total resource cost.
